message.reasoning_content:
Key facts so far:
- Signature: X-Hub-Signature-256, HMAC-SHA256 hex digest over the payload contents with the secret. Must verify raw bytes before parsing/re-serializing; never plain ==; use constant-time compare. Header absent if no secret configured.
- Timing: 2XX within 10 seconds; GitHub terminates and considers delivery failed.
- Redelivery: X-GitHub-Delivery same as original delivery when redelivered.
- Best practices: redeliver missed deliveries when server back up; use X-GitHub-Delivery to protect against replay.

Now I need the redelivering page to confirm the mechanics (manual redelivery via UI/API, same GUID) and whether GitHub automatically retries. The docs have "Automatically redelivering failed deliveries" pages which are user-written scripts — indication GitHub does not automatically redeliver for repo/org webhooks (GitHub Apps have automatic redelivery? Actually I recall for GitHub Apps, "GitHub does not automatically redeliver failed deliveries" — the docs say you can use the API to redeliver; there's a statement that GitHub Apps webhook deliveries can be redelivered...
